When the blade shines with a golden light, it will electrocute enemies struck by it.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 22 |durability = 36 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Thunderblade}} Thunderblades are a type of [[Weapon]] forged and refined by [[Lightning]] from the hills of [[Hyrule Ridge]]. They belong to the [[Magic Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons with elemental properties.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} Whenever the blade shines gold, any [[Enemy|Enemies]] struck by it are electrocuted. These swords are commonly found in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[West Necluda]]. Despite their elemental nature, Thunderblades can still conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] due to being made of metal. However, this also means that they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. While they sink if they are dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], they also do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_035" |Life = 36 |Power = 22 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 4000 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 1000 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 40.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 150 |BuyingPrice = 150 }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Great Thunderblade * Magic Gear * Thunderspear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Magic Gear, Swords, Weapons |items= BotW }}
